news.desc: THE GAMES: The No. 22 Oregon State men's soccer team will return to Paul Lorenz Field on Wednesday to take on CSU Bakersfield. The Beavers will follow that up by making a trip to Cal Poly on Saturday.

news.title: Beavers Headed to Ann Arbor for Exhibition Matchup with Michigan
news.desc: THE GAME: The Oregon State men's basketball team will take on Michigan Friday afternoon in an exhibition matchup in Ann Arbor, Mich.

news.title: Borso, Nicolson Earn Weekly Honors
news.desc: CORVALLIS – Oregon State standouts Wyatt Borso and John Nicolson have both earned Pac-12 weekly awards, the conference office announced Tuesday.

news.title: Ogbolu Tabbed as Pac-12 Newcomer of the Week
news.desc: CORVALLIS – Oregon State's Amber Ogbolu has been named Pac-12 Newcomer of the Week, the conference office announced Tuesday.

news.title: Stanley Lin Moves Into Tie For Second Through 36 Holes At The Bryson
news.desc: MIAMI – Stanley Lin climbed into a tie for second individually after the second round of The Bryson Tuesday, heading into the final round four shots off the lead.
